explanation.headline: Amiodarone hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list; both Corvale sites use product from Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), which received a VAI inspection on 2026-07-16

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows amiodarone hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 144 tablets of the 200 mg presentation, providing 9.8 days of supply at current use.
Corvale General holds 268 tablets of the same presentation, providing 17.8 days of supply.
Both sites' inventory is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (NDC 71335194204) and traces to FEI 1000519407.
FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended 2026-07-16 and was classified VAI.
The plant received an OAI classification in 2009 and a Warning Letter in 2010, but subsequent inspections through 2026 have been VAI.
The ranked transfer option moves 57 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving each site with at least 14 days on hand.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
